symptom: The research-only Outcome Learning Ledger accepted caller-owned objects after checking own data descriptors but later read scalar values through ordinary property gets. A synthetic Proxy can return an admissible payoutYen through get while its own descriptor contains a negative payout; canonical hashing uses the descriptor and therefore can digest a different invalid record. Revoked Proxy records and nested Proxy evidence arrays also lack a fail-closed ingress denial. No production settlement or private evidence was used.
lesson: The same untrusted Proxy get-versus-descriptor inconsistency affects the Outcome Ledger independently of the Runtime Ledger. Validation, append classification and canonical hashing must agree on one admitted own-data graph; shape checks alone do not establish that authority.
guardrail: Reuse the verified Node-only util.types.isProxy ingress denial before reading a caller-owned outcome record or its sourceEvidenceDigests array. Reject revoked root/nested Proxies, require normal records to retain canonical digests and append idempotency, and regress get/descriptor disagreement without invoking caller hooks. This is research-only integrity, not authenticated settlement or permission to change Current BUY.
